registryCustodian: Section Domaines et Cadastre, Direction Préfectorale de l'Urbanisme, de l'Habitat et de la Construction de Labé; national map host: Guinea Ministry of Mines and Geology
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries were performed. Both identified the first-party Guinea cadastre portal; French discovery also identified the official title-registration procedure and Labé-specific cadastral documentation. Search did not expose a safe anonymous parcel response.
requestOutcomes: The official ArcGIS REST directory responded, but the application-layer metadata, layers endpoint, and layer 0 endpoint returned ArcGIS 499 Token Required; the sharing endpoint returned HTTP 500. No credentials, private token, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe fields were used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [11.3198127122123, -12.2867227636163] was preserved and not moved.
Zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, token wall, or unusable UI was not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
A local Labé cadastral custodian and official national map lead are evidenced, but no public parcel schema, CRS, native ID, geometry, or citywide coverage was verified.
The Labé-specific documentary map reference is evidence of cadastral work and custodian, not an open parcel-level GeoJSON source; no geometry was retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON is included because no safe native parcel identity and polygon were observed.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: Local registry and official map lead evidence are sufficient for research completion, but token-gated anonymous parcel access prevented verification of ID+geometry and source schema; source admission is not justified.

uncertainty: Current JavaScript/configuration, token policy, parcel fields, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unverified. The exact-point coordinate was not used to infer absence.
